description: Turn a job description (any language, at least 30 characters) into the typed criteria it states (usually 4 to 10, fewer for a short posting), in the posting's order, each with a criterion_id, a label, a type, a requirement (required, preferred or bonus), a weight from 0 to 3 and an optional threshold. They are written in the job's language (English, French, German, Spanish or Portuguese; English for any other) unless language says otherwise. The job is stored under job_id, so score_resumes can reuse it. Free, except a new text sent under the job_id of a job already scored: its scores are evaluated again, 1 credit each.

job_id.description: Your id for this job (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters). Omit it: the job is stored under an id drawn from its text.

job_text.description: Full job description, as published: at least 30 characters.

language.description: Language of the criteria, summaries and explanations: en, fr, de, es or pt. Defaults to the language of the job's text (English when it is another).

workspace.description: The client company this call belongs to, when the user recruits for several companies: its HireLayer workspace id (letters, digits and . _ : ~ -, up to 200 characters), e.g. acme-corp. Jobs, resumes and scores stay apart from other clients'. A new id creates a new workspace, so reuse the exact id. Omit it for the user's default workspace.

name: extract_job_criteria
title: Job Criteria Extractor
